prompt: Which capabilities did AVEVA name for CONNECT at its 2024 launch? Select all that apply.

options.text: Replacing every on-premises PI Data Archive

explanation: CONNECT was described as offering "native data services, visualization services, modeling and analytics capabilities" on Microsoft Azure. AVEVA's hybrid offer augments, rather than replaces, the on-premises PI System.

prompt: In AVEVA's 2023 MQTT and EDS workshop, which tool was used to view EDS-sourced data that had been sent to Data Hub?
explanation: EDS-sourced data in Data Hub can be viewed with the Data Hub trend tool, while PI data can be viewed in PI Vision.

prompt: Which items appear in AVEVA's December 2025 list of CONNECT updates? Select all that apply.

options.text: AVEVA Asset Information Management integration in CONNECT visualization
A new version of PI ProcessBook

explanation: The 9 December 2025 blog lists Databricks integration, AIM integration in CONNECT visualization, Experience visualizations, asset and time context, and an Industrial AI Assistant in open preview. ProcessBook was retired.

prompt: On which cloud does AVEVA's CONNECT platform run, according to the launch coverage?
explanation: The April 2024 launch report says CONNECT runs on Microsoft Azure.

prompt: What is described as "the foundation of our industrial intelligence platform, CONNECT"?
explanation: AVEVA's July 2024 blog calls CONNECT data services, formerly AVEVA Data Hub, the foundation of CONNECT.

scenario: A company buys AVEVA PI Data Infrastructure. The plant manager asks whether operators must stop using PI Vision and move to the cloud.

options.text: No; the package augments the on-premises PI System and includes PI Vision alongside CONNECT data services
Yes; PI Vision is not part of the package
Yes; CONNECT replaces the PI Data Archive
No; but PI Vision must be replaced by ProcessBook

explanation: AVEVA PI Data Infrastructure "augments the on-premises PI System with cloud-enabled functionalities" and includes PI Vision, PI DataLink and PI Web API.

prompt: Which consumers of Data Views did AVEVA's 2023 session list? Select all that apply.

options.text: The AVEVA Data Hub Power BI Connector

explanation: Data Views consumers include the AVEVA Data Hub Power BI Connector and the REST API. PI ICU and PIBufss are on-premises data collection tools.

prompt: In AVEVA's 2023 connectivity architecture, what do edge devices pair and bootstrap to?
explanation: The 2023 architecture says edge devices pair and bootstrap to "AVEVA Connect, common cloud platform", which also lists visualization services.
